final-grade-calculator.workedExample:
Current grade 85%, final worth 30%, target 90%:

1. Points locked = 85 x (1 - 0.30) = 59.5.
2. Required = (90 - 59.5) / 0.30 = 30.5 / 0.30 = 101.7%.
3. Verdict: impossible — even a perfect final only reaches 89.5%.
4. Lower the target to 89%: (89 - 59.5) / 0.30 = 98.3% — possible but tough.

Aim for the A- instead of the A, and study accordingly.
